nodes.description: Create a detailed outline for the log-aggregator design covering the 5 required modules and how they communicate
Specify the config-loading module: configuration file schema, key data structures, complete function signatures, error-handling strategy, and integration with the main pipeline

Specify the log-parsing module: input formats, tokenization/parsing rules, data structure for log entries, complete function signatures, and how parsed entries are passed to the filter/aggregation stage

Specify the filtering and aggregation module: filter expression/rule representation, aggregation operators, key data structures, complete function signatures, and interaction with the parser and formatter
Specify the output-formatting module: supported output formats, formatter trait definitions, complete function signatures, and how aggregated results are rendered
Specify the main orchestration module: module dependency graph, data flow between modules, complete main() execution sequence, error handling boundaries, and CLI entry points

Write the final detailed design document in Chinese, at least 700 characters, covering all 5 modules with function signatures, key data structures, core implementation ideas, module communication, and the complete main() flow
